name: Space Misadventures DX
storyline:
As you traverse the depths of space, your ship loaded with the bounty of your last adventures... your trusty ship's AI raises the alarm. Something has gone awry with your cargo!
What sexy shenanigans could be awaiting you? Will you reach the extremely NSFW ending? Will you find the hidden scenes and collectables? Will you enjoy your Vaguely Erotic Space Misadventure (in Space)? Will we ever make more of this? Only one way to find out!
summary: Space Misadventures is a classic Point and Click adventure game... for adults.
